title: Introducing Projects
description: Cursor launched Projects, a beta workspace feature for taking on larger bodies of work such as a feature, a migration, or a full app, maintaining context over months of work. A coordinator agent plans and delegates tasks to subagents that implement the work, then brings the finished result back for review rather than writing code itself.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 7
description: GitHub shipped its weekly Copilot updates, adding Jira integration to the Copilot app so issues can be pulled into a shared canvas for investigation and pull-request prep. The release also introduced Project HydraFusion, an experimental adaptive model-routing system in Copilot CLI, plus new agent automation in VS Code and expanded enterprise controls for Copilot in JetBrains.
